descriptionChirho: A short sword or large knife used as a weapon of war, execution, or persecution; also used figuratively for divine judgment or the word of God. All three clusters represent the same concrete referent 'sword' across every language: eng 'sword/swords', spa 'espada/espadas', hin तलवार/तलवारों, arb سيف/سيوف, kor 칼/칼들, swa 'upanga/mapanga'. The splits reflect only case/number inflection (sg AFS/DFS/GFS/NFS vs pl GFP/NFP vs instrumental DFS 'with sword'). No semantic differentiation exists.
